nodes.label: Rationale for USD-only application boundary
nodes.rationale: Forzar USD en cada nueva operacion evita FX y mantiene enteros en unidades menores sin relabeling del historial financiero existente, simplificando el piloto mientras se preservan currency/Currency/PaymentProvider para trazabilidad y expansion futura.

nodes.label: Rationale for the single-merchant Sandbox fallback
nodes.rationale: Permite ejercitar checkout, captura, webhook verificado, ledger, saldo, recibo y push reales en Sandbox sin credenciales Multiparty, restringido explicitamente a PAYPAL_ENVIRONMENT=sandbox para que nunca se use con dinero real.

nodes.label: PayPal Connected-Account No-Custody Model
nodes.rationale: Creators connect their own PayPal account via Partner Referrals onboarding so PayPal disburses tips directly and TipMe never custodies funds; TipMe only records provider identifiers, capability state, and confirms via verified webhook, trading direct-settlement independence against dependency on PayPal Multiparty partner approval.

nodes.label: Whop Connected-Account Direct Charge Model
nodes.rationale: Each creator operates a Whop connected company; direct charges route funds to the connected account so TipMe never custodies funds, offloads KYC/payouts to Whop's hosted portal, and takes only a 1% application_fee_amount, trading custody risk for dependency on Whop for Platforms approval.

nodes.label: Mercado Pago OAuth Connected-Account Split Model
nodes.rationale: Creator connects their own Mercado Pago account via OAuth PKCE per country (MX/CO); TipMe charges application_fee via split payments so the creator's account receives funds directly and TipMe never custodies money, trading local settlement for country-specific credential and currency complexity.
nodes.norm_label: mercado pago oauth connected-account split model

nodes.label: Centralized Collection + Automated Payouts Pattern
nodes.rationale: TipMe collects to its own PayPal Business account and automatically redistributes creator net via the Payouts API so the pilot can launch before PayPal grants Multiparty partner approval; the trade-off is that TipMe temporarily commingles creator funds and absorbs pooled-liquidity and dispute risk that Multiparty would have avoided.

nodes.label: Single-Merchant Sandbox Fallback
nodes.rationale: A Sandbox-only single-TipMe-merchant order flow (omitting payee/platform_fees) lets the team exercise the full checkout-to-webhook-to-ledger pipeline before PayPal grants Multiparty approval, explicitly disclosed as simulated and blocked from Live by configuration validation.

nodes.label: USD-Only Currency and Neutral Language Policy
nodes.rationale: TipMe standardizes all new operations on USD and removes currency selection so the money model, ledger, and PaymentProvider abstraction stay simple; historical non-USD records are preserved unmodified rather than falsely reinterpreted, trading multi-currency flexibility for reduced accounting complexity in the MVP.
nodes.norm_label: usd-only currency and neutral language policy

nodes.label: Single-Screen Checkout Pattern
nodes.rationale: Both CardFields and the PayPal button share one lazy, promise-cached createOrder callback triggered only on final submission, collapsing a two-step tip-then-pay flow into one ENVIAR TIP click while keeping the browser unable to confirm payment or create duplicate orders.

nodes.label: Card-First Fallback Pattern
nodes.rationale: Card Fields (number/expiry/CVV only) are shown as the sole initial payment option when eligible, with the PayPal button appearing only as fallback when Card Fields is ineligible, to minimize friction and avoid requiring PayPal login for most fans.

nodes.label: Derived Non-Editable Total Pattern
nodes.rationale: Total retirado is derived read-only from immutable ledger_entries of type payout that reach completed status, avoiding any new writable or duplicated financial total column, grouped per currency without conversion.
